meta_description: R&J Tree Services Birmingham offers expert tree surgery, felling, and maintenance. Fully insured, qualified arborists. Free quotes — call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborists — Local Birmingham Tree Experts
hero_subhead: Dangerous branch hanging over your home? We assess, plan, and remove safely — same-week appointments available.
services_heading: Complete Tree Care Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From routine pruning to complex felling, we handle every aspect of tree management with safety and precision.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, planned removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle large specimens and awkward locations, clearing debris throughout.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Shaping
services.desc: Reduce weight and improve tree shape to restore vigour and light. Perfect for overhanging branches and storm-damaged trees.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cutting keeps boundaries neat and promotes healthy growth. We work to your preferred height and density.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen trees, split limbs, and storm debris cleared quickly and safely. We're available 24/7 for urgent callouts.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Expert inspection identifies disease, structural faults, and pest damage. We advise on treatment or safe removal options.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Complete stump extraction below ground level. Clears the site and removes regrowth risk — perfect for new landscaping projects.

about_pullquote: We climb every tree like it's in our own garden.
about_para_1: R&J Tree Services was founded over 15 years ago by two climbers who were tired of seeing poor, unsafe work in the Birmingham area. We've grown into a trusted team of certified arborists and ground staff, completing over 2,000 tree jobs across the West Midlands. Every member holds current qualifications in arboriculture and rigorous safety training.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honesty and attention. We turn up on time, explain what we're doing in plain English, and leave your garden spotless. Repeat customers make up 60% of our work — because once you've seen us handle a tricky removal or storm damage, you know you can rely on us.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Massive oak tree was leaning towards the house after the storm. R&J came out same day, assessed it properly, and got it down safely without damaging anything. Professional crew, knew exactly what they were doing. Really pleased with the job.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using them for three years now for our hedge. They're reliable, always turn up when promised, and the price is fair. The garden looks brilliant after they've been. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Emergency callout at 10pm because a branch came down on the fence. They were here within an hour, cleared it all, and sorted everything before we had to pay a fortune. Absolutely top service. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: James M.
